title: Crispy Chickpea and Moroccan Pudding Bites
description: A unique dessert with a sweet and crunchy combination of crispy chickpea bites and creamy moroccan pudding.
instructions: Rinse the chickpeas and dry them thoroughly.
In a bowl, mix together the chickpeas, sugar, and lively lemon zest.
Pour the mixture onto a baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes, or until crispy.
In a separate bowl, mix together the moroccan pudding mix, butter, and vanilla extract.
Pour the pudding mixture into individual cups or ramekins.
Top each pudding with a few crispy chickpea bites.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving.
